svg.text: GENERAL ARRANGEMENT · VARIANT 7 · DIMENSIONS IN MM · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION
TPE mouthpiece · lip bump · lip-stop flange
Colour-coded TPU belt, shortest girth (7 = blue)
Flush cap, O-ring sealed over USB-C
Short TPU tether, anchored on the back faces
1. Body ABS/PC, safety orange #E8590C, matte · overmolds TPE · plug stainless
2. Whistle chambers Ø6 × 26.8 / 28.8 / 31.0 (~7 % steps → beating tones)
3. Drain port at each chamber floor · windows behind lip-stop flange
4. Sealed USB-C: O-ring on the plug boss, gasket liner in the cap
